# Vendored third-party libraries

| directory | what | version | license |
|---|---|---|---|
| `CLI11/` | [CLI11](https://github.com/CLIUtils/CLI11), command-line parsing of the `cgdbe` driver (single header) | 2.7.2 | BSD 3-clause (`CLI11/LICENSE`) |

To update CLI11, replace `CLI11/CLI11.hpp` by the `CLI11.hpp` of a release
(<https://github.com/CLIUtils/CLI11/releases>) and its `LICENSE`.
